fintech.name: Acquiring bank outage
fintech.description: An ordinary weekday evening. At 18:40 the main acquiring bank stops answering card and UPI authorisations for two hours. Without a circuit breaker, every payment waits for its timeout and checkout queues behind it.

effects.label: The main acquiring bank stops answering authorisations
effects.prevented: The circuit breaker tripped in 20 seconds and sent payments to the backup acquirer
effects.recovered: The acquiring bank is answering again

fintech.name: Month-end batch overruns
fintech.description: On the 1st, the month-end settlement batch runs four hours late and holds most database connections from 09:00 to 12:00, just as salary payments start to arrive.

effects.label: The late settlement batch holds 70% of the database connections
effects.recovered: The batch finishes and releases its connections

fintech.name: UPI switch slows down
fintech.description: A weekday evening. At 19:00 the UPI switch starts taking 30 seconds to answer. Without timeouts on the UPI path, every waiting payment holds a gateway thread, and the gateway runs out of them.

effects.label: UPI responses take 30 seconds; gateway threads wait on them
effects.recovered: The UPI switch answers in time again

fintech.name: Read replica falls behind
fintech.description: At 16:20 the read replica falls 40 seconds behind the primary. Risk checks and merchant reports read stale balances, and risk starts rejecting good payments until someone notices.

effects.label: Risk checks read 40-second-old balances and reject good payments
effects.prevented: The lag alert fired at 10 seconds and reads moved to the primary

fintech.name: API-key rotation goes wrong
fintech.description: A security release rotates merchant API keys at 11:00. The old keys stay cached, so merchants' calls are rejected until someone flushes the cache by hand.

effects.label: Rotated API keys stay cached; merchants' calls are rejected
effects.prevented: Rotation invalidated the key cache; merchants noticed nothing
effects.recovered: Someone flushes the key cache by hand

healthtech.name: SMS gateway outage on a Monday
healthtech.description: A Monday morning OPD. At 08:25 the SMS gateway stops accepting token and lab-report messages for two hours. Registration waits on each SMS, so the counters slow down and then stop.

effects.label: The SMS gateway stops accepting token and report messages
effects.prevented: Messages waited in the queue and went out when the gateway came back
effects.recovered: The SMS gateway accepts messages again

healthtech.name: Interface engine restart
healthtech.description: At 14:10 the HL7 interface engine restarts after a memory alarm and loses its in-memory queue. Lab orders, results and vitals stop flowing between systems until the queue is rebuilt.

effects.label: The HL7 engine restarts and drops its in-memory message queue
effects.prevented: The durable queue kept every message; the restart took 40 seconds
effects.recovered: The interface engine is processing messages again

healthtech.name: Vitals history slows the database
healthtech.description: The vitals table has passed 400 million rows. On a busy day every query on it gets a little slower each hour, and by the evening rounds the shared database is struggling.

effects.label: Queries on the vitals history slow down hour by hour

healthtech.name: Lab interface release breaks results
healthtech.description: A new lab interface goes live at 11:00 and maps result codes wrongly. Results are rejected, doctors wait for reports, and the old version has to be restored.

effects.label: The new lab interface maps result codes wrongly; results are rejected
effects.prevented: Contract tests failed the release before it reached the wards
effects.recovered: The previous interface version is restored

ecommerce.name: Full catalogue reindex at noon
ecommerce.description: A sale weekday. A price change at noon triggers a full re-index of the catalogue, and for two hours every search waits behind it.

effects.label: A full catalogue re-index makes every search wait

ecommerce.name: Bulk price update before the flash sale
ecommerce.description: At 19:00 the bulk price job rewrites 2 lakh prices row by row and locks the catalogue, just as shoppers arrive for the 8 pm flash sale.

effects.label: The bulk price job locks catalogue rows one by one

ecommerce.name: Campaign change breaks coupons
ecommerce.description: At 20:05 marketing switches the evening campaign. The coupon cache keeps the old rules, so checkout rejects valid coupons and orders fail until the cache is cleared.

effects.label: The coupon cache keeps the old campaign; checkout rejects valid coupons
effects.prevented: The campaign change invalidated the coupon cache at once

ecommerce.name: Order events replayed
ecommerce.description: After a message broker restart at 15:00, six hours of order events are replayed. The warehouse processes them again, double-reserving stock and flooding inventory for three hours.

effects.label: The warehouse processes six hours of order events twice

college.name: OTP SMS fails on revaluation results day
college.description: Revaluation results come out at 10:00. At 10:05 the SMS provider stops sending login OTPs for two hours, and because login waits on the OTP, results stop loading too.

effects.label: The SMS provider stops sending login OTPs
effects.prevented: OTPs were queued and resent as soon as the provider recovered
effects.recovered: The SMS provider is sending again

college.name: Fee deadline evening
college.description: The fee deadline is midnight. From 18:00 the bank's callbacks time out and each payment is retried three times, so fees carries four times its usual load all evening.

effects.label: Bank callbacks time out and every payment is retried three times
effects.recovered: The bank's callbacks speed up again

college.name: Biometric sync floods the database
college.description: At 09:30 the biometric machines sync the morning's attendance, one row and one transaction at a time, while faculty are marking attendance for first period.

effects.label: Ten thousand single-row attendance saves hit the database

college.name: Grading rule change breaks SGPA
college.description: A release at 11:00 changes the grading rules in one of the three places they live. Result pages compute SGPA wrongly and fail until the release is reverted.

effects.label: The new grading rules compute SGPA wrongly; result pages fail
effects.prevented: With one shared rules module, the change was tested before release
